# Strata Noble

> Strata Noble installs operational control systems for service businesses — powered by Q SUITE, verified through ProofLoop, delivered through ANX Vault.

Strata Noble is a builder-operator consulting firm headquartered in Las Vegas, NV. We design and install business infrastructure for service businesses: intake systems, CRM workflows, revenue tracking, automations, and accountability systems. We do not do generic agency work. Every engagement delivers a documented, running system.

## What We Do

- **Systems Audit** — Operational infrastructure audit with prioritized fixes and ProofLoop receipts. Turnaround 48–72 hours. Entry point for most engagements.
- **Process Improvement Sprint** — Targeted fix for a specific broken system: intake, follow-up, tracking, or reporting.
- **Operations Buildout** — 21-day full infrastructure install: workflows, CRM, automations, reporting dashboards, and team training. Verified delivery.
- **Operations Command** — Ongoing monthly operational support and optimization.

## Our Technology

- **Q SUITE** — Proprietary business platform: client tracking, revenue visibility, follow-up automation, and secure credential storage. Same stack we run Strata Noble on.
- **ProofLoop** — Delivery verification system. Every engagement produces a proof receipt documenting what was built, tested, and handed over.
- **ANX Vault** — Secure credential and operations infrastructure management.
- **ACHIEVERY** — Accountability and goal-tracking product for service business operators and teams.
